title: Quantified rigidity of $\mathcal{A}$-free Young measure concentrations
summary: We establish quantitative stability of the De Philippis--Rindler rigidity on conical convex regions. By constructing $\mathcal{A}$-quasiconvex functions with a tailored concavity---which additionally yields a new, elementary proof of the original theorem for constant-rank operators---we prove a spreading inequality that strictly limits the angular concentration of $\mathcal{A}$-free measures.
